description: Create a sequence (Stage 9 timeline) inside a project — START HERE to turn generated shots into something the continuity pass can read. The new sequence is EMPTY: add shots with lab_add_clip before anything else works. lab_continuity_check rejects an empty timeline with 400. Returns the sequence record including its `id`.

project_id.description: Project id (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string

title.description: Sequence title. Defaults to 'Main Sequence' on the backend
